Game Overview

In Fly Witch, the core idea is straightforward: guide an enchanting witch through a dynamic obstacle course. With intuitive tap controls, navigate past wooden boxes, collect medals, and soar to new heights. Each flight increases in speed and challenge, promising endless fun and rewarding skill development in this charming arcade adventure. Aim for a high score!

Playing Fly Witch comes down to a simple loop. Guide an enchanting witch through a dynamic obstacle course!
